verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI's own docs say it ships TestModel and FunctionModel for testing and development, and a community user confirms you can mock the LLM client for testing. That covers the mocked-model half of the story. The evidence is a single brief docs mention, and nothing shows how tools are mocked or overridden in unit tests. Missing for 10: documented mocking or overriding of tools in tests, in-depth testing docs (e.g. how TestModel or FunctionModel drive tool calls and assertions), hands-on corroboration of a unit-test workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can unit-test agents with mocked models and tools

citations.quote: Pydantic AI also comes with TestModel and FunctionModel for testing and development.
